en: The postcard displays a historical street view featuring the façade of 'Hôtel Paradies' in a European city. Visible in the foreground are people and a horse-drawn carriage in front of the hotel, with several multi-story buildings lining the street. The style is black and white with a sepia tone, typical of early 20th-century postcards. There is ornate fencing along the street, and signage for 'Café & Restaurant' is also visible.
